A box has dimensions 3 cm by 4 cm by 12 cm. What is the length of the space diagonal (the longest diagonal through the interior)?
questions.explanation: Space diagonal = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2 + 12^2) = sqrt(9 + 16 + 144) = sqrt(169) = 13 cm.

questions.explanation: Space diagonal = sqrt(2^2 + 1^2 + 1^2) = sqrt(4 + 1 + 1) = sqrt(6) = 2.449 m. Since 2.449 < 2.5, the rod will NOT fit.
